notablePrerequisites: You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor, targeting any creature card in your graveyard.
Bone Miser triggers twice, adding {B}{B} and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning any creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding any creature card, targeting Dryad Arbor.
Bone Miser triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
